rules.description: The `profile.md` declaration and the root index MUST both declare `okf_version` `"0.2"`.
rules.message: The declaration, root index, and Profile release must all bind to OKF 0.2.

rules.description: The root `profile.md` MUST be an ordinary concept of `type: Knowledge Profile`.
rules.message: profile.md must have type Knowledge Profile.

rules.description: A concept MUST carry nonempty `type`, `title`, `description`, and `status` fields.
rules.message: Every concept must contain non-empty string values for type, title, description, and status.

rules.description: Concepta producers MUST NOT introduce namespaced or otherwise producer-defined frontmatter fields.
rules.message: Concepta producers may use only OKF 0.2 frontmatter fields; found {failing}.

rules.description: A concept's `status` MUST be `draft`, `stable`, or `deprecated`.
rules.message: Status must be draft, stable, or deprecated.

rules.description: A tag MUST NOT exactly repeat the concept's `type`, `status`, derived trust tier, or a standard relationship label.
rules.message: Tags must not duplicate type, status, trust, or standard relationship values; found {failing}.

rules.description: A concept carries no `generated` field recording how its current content was produced.
rules.message: Generation provenance is recommended when it is known.

rules.description: A bundle MUST contain a type registry at `types.md`.
rules.message: The bundle must contain types.md.

rules.description: The type registry at `types.md` MUST be an ordinary concept of `type: Type Registry`.
rules.message: types.md must have type Type Registry.

rules.description: The type registry table MUST use exactly the columns `Type` and `Intended content`, in that order.
rules.message: The type registry must use exactly Type and Intended content columns.

rules.description: The type registry MUST open with all fourteen standard types in canonical order and with their exact meanings.
rules.message: The type registry must contain all fourteen canonical standard rows.

rules.description: Project-specific type rows MUST follow all standard rows in case-sensitive lexical order.
rules.message: Project type rows must follow the standards in lexical order.

rules.description: Every used type MUST resolve in the type registry at `types.md`.
rules.message: Used type {type} must be registered in types.md.

rules.description: The type registry lists a project-specific type, which is conformant.
rules.message: Registered project types are conformant and should inform later Profile releases.

rules.description: A bundle MUST carry an actor registry at root `actors.md` whenever any concept uses an actor identifier in `generated.by`, `verified[].by`, or `sources[].author`.
rules.message: actors.md is required whenever an OKF actor-valued field is used.

rules.description: The actor registry at `actors.md` MUST be an ordinary concept of `type: Actor Registry`.
rules.message: actors.md must have type Actor Registry.

rules.description: The actor registry table MUST have exactly the columns `Actor ID`, `Name`, `Organization`, `Side`, `Role`, and `Active`, in that order.
rules.message: The actor registry must use the six fixed columns in canonical order.

rules.description: Every actor registry row MUST carry a nonempty `Actor ID`, `Name`, `Organization`, `Side`, `Role`, and `Active` value.
rules.message: Actor rows must contain an ID, name, organization, side, role, and active value.

rules.description: An actor's `Side` MUST be exactly one of `client`, `internal`, `vendor`, `tool`, or `unknown`.
rules.message: Actor Side must use the closed Profile vocabulary.

rules.description: An actor's `Active` value MUST be `YYYY-MM-DD – YYYY-MM-DD` with the start inclusive and end exclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD –` for an open-ended period, or `unknown`.
rules.message: Actor Active values must be unknown or valid inclusive-exclusive date ranges.

rules.description: The dated `Active` periods of one actor ID MUST NOT overlap.
rules.message: Dated Active periods for one actor must not overlap.

rules.description: The actor registry MUST contain every actor ID used by the bundle.
rules.message: Used actor {id} must be represented in actors.md.

rules.description: When `sources` is present, every entry MUST be a mapping carrying the nonempty `resource` OKF requires.
rules.message: Every present source entry must be a mapping with a non-empty resource.

rules.description: Within one concept, each present `sources[].id` MUST be unique.
rules.message: Source IDs must be unique within a concept.

rules.description: A body footnote reference whose label exactly matches a `sources[].id` is source attribution and MUST join to its footnote definition.
rules.message: A recognized source-attribution reference must join to its footnote definition.

rules.description: A top-level `resource` or `sources[].resource` written as a path resolves to no existing file or directory.
rules.message: Source path {target} does not resolve to a file or directory.

rules.description: Each `# Relationships` bullet MUST carry exactly one label and one Markdown link target.
rules.message: Each Relationships entry must contain exactly one label and one Markdown target.

rules.description: A `# Relationships` bullet uses an additional label outside the preferred standard labels.
rules.message: The relationship label {label} is a permitted project extension.

rules.description: The §7.1 link rules MUST be assessed against a buildable OKF link graph of the bundle.
rules.message: The OKF link graph could not be built ({error}); the §7.1 link rules were not assessed.

rules.description: An internal link uses a target without the leading `/` of a bundle-relative link.
rules.message: Internal links should use bundle-relative targets.

rules.description: An internal link's target is absent from the bundle.
rules.message: An unresolved internal link is permitted and remains an OKF graph edge.

rules.description: A `raw/` tier belongs to a source directory and MUST NOT sit directly under `references/`.
rules.message: A raw/ tier belongs to a source directory; raw/ must not sit directly under references/.

rules.description: Within `raw/` and any of its subdirectories under `references/`, the only markdown file permitted is each directory's own `index.md`.
rules.message: A raw/ tier holds verbatim originals; the only markdown permitted in it is each directory's own index.md.

rules.description: A bundle MUST contain `index.md`, `log.md`, `profile.md`, and `types.md` at its root and reserves the names `profile.md`, `types.md`, and `actors.md` for those bundle-root structural files.

message.missing: The bundle root must contain index.md, log.md, profile.md, and types.md; missing {failing}.
message.reserved: profile.md, types.md, and actors.md are reserved for their bundle-root structural purposes.

rules.description: A nonempty directory MUST contain an `index.md`, including every area, sub-area, `references/`, and nonempty subdirectory of `references/`.
rules.message: Every nonempty directory must contain index.md.

rules.description: A concept sits beside an area of the same name rather than inside it.
rules.message: A concept beside an area of the same name needs contextual placement review.

rules.description: Every index MUST be the deterministic semantic projection of its directory.
rules.message: The index must exactly match its immediate semantic projection.

rules.description: Every root `log.md` entry MUST start with a nonempty bold lead word followed by a colon.
rules.message: Every root log entry must begin with a nonempty bold lead word and a colon.
